<!-- Top Bar Hide - Abir -->
<script>
  const closeButton = document.querySelector('.top_bar_cls_btn');
  const topBar = document.querySelector('.top_bar_show_hide');

  if (closeButton && topBar) {
    closeButton.addEventListener('click', function () {
      topBar.style.display = 'none';
    });
  }
</script>
